messages:
katie: Quick check — planning to enable `feature.autoscale.queueing_v2` for a 10% canary in prod tonight. Aim is to reduce tail latency for small requests without changing max_concurrency guardrail. Anyone object?
raj: what's the canary audience exactly? internal + beta tenants only?
katie: yes — internal + tenants with `flag:beta`. Rollout selectors: region=us-west, env=prod, tag=beta.
mike: what's the safety net if queueing_v2 spikes errors or increases token cost? fallback plan?
katie: fallback = immediate rollback to v1 if error rate > 0.5% over 1m, and an auto-disable if token spend grows >15% vs baseline in 5m window. Also burst throttle remains in place.
sophia: can you add a short smoke test and a minimal canary dashboard card (latency, queue depth, error rate)? I can wire the dashboard once you drop the metrics list.
katie: list: p95 latency, avg queue depth, 5m error rate, token/sec. I'll push a tiny smoke test to canary that sends 100 small requests/sec for 2m.
mike: please include a runbook snippet for rollback. shorthand:
```
# rollback
/feature toggle disable feature.autoscale.queueing_v2 --scope canary
# verify: smoke test returns baseline, dashboard p95 within thresholds
```
I'll add to eng-playbooks. Also pinging @oncall-bot to schedule a 30m watch window after flip.
oncall-bot: @katie scheduled: Watch window 30m starting at 23:00 UTC. Reminder notifications to oncall and platform leads.
deploy-bot: deploy dry-run passed against canary pool. no config conflicts detected.
raj: small note — last time a queueing change briefly bypassed the max_concurrency cap for ~45s; please confirm the runtime path checks guardrails before queueing logic.
katie: confirmed in the patch: guardrail enforcement happens in the admission layer before queueing decision. added unit test `TestGuardrailRespected` and a quick integration smoke.
olivia: will this touch dedicated pools? we must avoid noisy neighbors for paying dedicated customers.
katie: dedicated pools are excluded by selector (`dedicated=true` excluded). canary only targets shared prod pools.
sophia: lgtm from observability side — i'll post dashboard link here once ready and watch first 30m. :thumbsup: 
mike: approve from infra side. :white_check_mark:
raj: platform approve, no blockers.
katie: thanks all — I'll flip at 23:00 UTC, run the smoke, and post results here.
